channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Driver faces DUI, child neglect charges after 3 kids injured in Largo crash: LPD
item.description: The Largo Police Department said a man is facing DUI and child neglect charges after crashing with three juvenile passengers in the car on Sunday evening.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tate brothers' lawyers and prosecutors to set schedule for UK extradition fight
item.description: Attorneys for Andrew and Tristan Tate will meet with federal prosecutors in Miami on Monday to work out a schedule for the potentially months long process of fighting extradition to the UK.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] One in five Americans are using their personal savings to pay for groceries
item.description: As people across the country struggle to make ends meet, a recent study found that one in five Americans are dipping into their savings accounts to pay for groceries.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] McConnell remains in rehab, not yet cleared to return to work
item.description: Sen. Mitch McConnell's doctor said Monday that the 84-year-old has not yet been medically cleared to leave a rehabilitation facility and return to work.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Rural Americans fight to keep local hospitals open amid closure fears
item.description: A new report flags 13 rural Virginia hospitals as at risk of closure — and 700 more across the U.S. face the same threat.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] PSTA launches new bus route connecting St. Petersburg to Tampa International Airport
item.description: Travelers and workers heading between downtown St. Petersburg and Tampa International Airport will soon have a faster, low-cost transit option across Tampa Bay.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Suspected hit-and-run driver crashes into 2 Hernando County patrol cars while trying to escape deputies: HCSO
item.description: A man faces multiple charges after hitting two patrol vehicles and a civilian car during a reckless driving getaway attempt in Weeki Wachee on Sunday, according to the Hernando County Sheriff's Office.
